lastCompletedStory.title: Extract the production preflight spawn closure into a real-boundary-tested sibling module

nextStoryContext: US-002 extracted the sole production PlanPreflightSpawnFn closure (the Bun.spawnSync(cwd)+decode-stdout+decode-stderr wrapper previously inlined at sidecar.ts:2638-2646, the exact seam where CAM-363's stderr drop hid) into `export function makePreflightSpawnFn(cwd: string): PlanPreflightSpawnFn` in the new flat sibling module src/supervisor/plan-preflight-spawn.ts, importing the type from ./plan-preflight.ts (not redeclaring it). sidecar.ts now does `const preflightSpawnFn: PlanPreflightSpawnFn = makePreflightSpawnFn(cwd);` and imports the factory from '../supervisor/plan-preflight-spawn.ts'. The sibling loopSpawnFn closure (same stderr-drop shape but a DIFFERENT type, LoopSpawnFn, with no stderr field) was deliberately left untouched, per the story's out-of-scope guard -- do not extract it under this story's precedent without a dedicated story, since its type shape differs and merging the two seams was explicitly out of scope here. sidecar.ts net-shrank from 3437 to 3431 lines (6 fewer; the file-size ceiling in scripts/file-size-budget.json was NOT touched/raised). The new module is covered by a REAL-subprocess test file (test/supervisor/plan/plan-preflight-spawn.test.ts) using `sh -c` for deterministic stderr/stdout/both/exit-code cases and a real mkdtempSync temp dir (realpathSync-resolved on both sides to dodge the macOS /var->/private/var symlink false-fail) for the cwd-honored case, plus a non-vacuity check that a different cwd yields a different decoded pwd. No fakes were used anywhere in that file. Step 5.5 confirmed against Bun's official spawn docs: SyncSubprocess.stdout/stderr are Buffer (or undefined if not captured) and spawnSync does not throw on non-zero exit -- the existing `instanceof Buffer` guard and direct `exitCode` check are correct and were preserved byte-for-byte, not 'simplified' to `.toString()`. Full `bun run check:all` spine was green (tests 5189 pass/0 fail, lint, file-size, debt-markers, version-skips, coverage, dead-code, dup, ci-parity, agents-md, test-sleeps); the 'push rejected'/'suggestions.jsonl missing on main' lines in the check:all output are pre-existing harness self-checks unrelated to this story's diff and were not introduced by this change.

officialDocsValidated.summary: Confirmed SyncSubprocess.stdout/stderr are Buffer|undefined (the instanceof Buffer guard is required, not optional) and spawnSync does not throw on non-zero exit; exitCode is the correct field. Implementation preserved the guard exactly, per story notes.
